fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Must have completed at least 1 year of university-level study prior to participation.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Mapped from University-wide scope in Excel partner list.

min_gpa_host.notes: Study Abroad & Exchange requirement is 3.3/4.0 GPA or equivalent (UK 2:1 standard); also confirmed in 2020-21 Fact Sheet #page=2.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: English proficiency required (department bands typically require IELTS 7.0 overall with 6.5 per skill or accepted TOEFL equivalents; full-year Student Visa applicants must meet UKVI English rules, while single-semester students may submit an institutional B2+ letter using King's template). Check https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/applying/entry-requirements. No RHET 1020 exemption stated.

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn 2026 (reference term-time schedule, though AUC Excel row restricts to Summer): Orientation 21-25 Sep 2026; Teaching begins 28 Sep 2026 (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/key-dates).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027 (reference term-time schedule, though AUC Excel row restricts to Summer): Orientation 18-22 Jan 2027; Teaching begins 25 Jan 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: Undergraduate Summer School 2027 sessions run 5-16 Jul and 19-30 Jul 2027 per https://www.kcl.ac.uk/summer/undergraduate.

tuition_model.notes: AUC Excel agreement limits available_terms to Summer only. KCL term-time exchange agreements waive tuition (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/choose-us/fees-and-funding), whereas Undergraduate Summer School lists standard fee-paying tuition GBP 2,650 (1 session) / GBP 5,100 (2 sessions) on https://www.kcl.ac.uk/summer/undergraduate; AUC bilateral Summer waiver terms are not verified in local files.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official KCL London student living expenses estimate is GBP 1,770/month (covering housing, food, travel, personal items).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD benchmark from official GBP 1,770/month London budget (GBP 1,770 x 5 = GBP 8,850) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 cross-rate (1 EUR = 0.83559 GBP, 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 GBP = 1.322658 USD, collected 2026-11-15 via https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html). Note AUC Excel row restricts agreement to Summer.

housing_availability.notes: Fact Sheet #page=3 states: 'Accommodation for incoming Study Abroad students is readily available, but not guaranteed.'

housing_notes.value: Accommodation for incoming Study Abroad students via King's Residences is readily available, but not guaranteed (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/accommodation; application at https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/accommodation/apply/apply).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Short-term stays <=6 months (such as Summer School or single semester) typically fall under UK Standard Visitor / ETA rules; stays >6 months require a UK Student Visa with UKVI English & maintenance proof (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/applying/how-to-apply; pre-arrival advice linked in 2020-21 Fact Sheet #page=3 at https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/pre-arrival-support/advice-for-offer-holders).

credit_system_and_load.value: KCL credit system (15 KCL credits = ~7.5 ECTS); normal term-time semester load is 4 x 15-credit modules (UG) or 3 x 20-credit modules (PG).

course_restrictions_note.value: AUC Excel agreement restricts KCL to Summer UG level (Undergraduate Summer School dates 5-16 Jul and 19-30 Jul 2027 at https://www.kcl.ac.uk/summer/undergraduate). For term-time Study Abroad, Biomedical Engineering, Biosciences, Chemistry, Informatics, Mathematics, Music, Pharmacy, Physics, and Nutrition modules require departmental academic approval with transcript & personal statement (Fact Sheet #page=3).

campus_type.notes: Multiple central London campuses (Strand, Waterloo, Guy's, St Thomas', Denmark Hill).

nomination_deadlines.value: Term-time AY 2026-27 (reference): Autumn exchange nomination 15 Jan - 15 Mar 2026, app deadline 31 Mar 2026; Spring exchange nomination 15 Aug - 1 Oct 2026, app deadline 15 Oct 2026 (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/abroad/key-dates). Summer School follows separate deadlines at https://www.kcl.ac.uk/summer/undergraduate.
